privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.badge: Your photos stay on your device.

local.title: Processed on your phone
local.body: Cropping, resizing, compression, conversion, filters, text, watermarks and collages are computed on this device. ImageCraft has no server and never uploads your photos.

noAccount.title: No account
noAccount.body: You don't need to sign up or give an email address. Nothing identifies you.

permissions.title: Only the photos you choose
permissions.body: ImageCraft uses the Android photo picker: it can only open the photos you select. No access to your whole gallery, camera or location.

storage.title: Private storage
storage.body: Results and project copies are kept in ImageCraft's private folder until you delete them. Temporary files are removed automatically. Image pixels are never stored in the app database.

ads.title: Advertising
ads.body: The free version shows a few ads from Google AdMob. Where required, you are asked for consent first. Ads never see your photos. Premium removes ads.

analytics.title: Anonymous statistics
analytics.body: Off by default. If you turn them on, only anonymous events are counted (for example "image compressed" and the format). Never photos, file names, paths or metadata.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.body: Premium is handled by Google Play and RevenueCat. ImageCraft never sees your payment details.

deletion.title: Delete everything
deletion.body: Settings → Delete all my data removes the history and every file ImageCraft created on this device.

welcome.title: Welcome to ImageCraft
welcome.body: Edit, resize, compress and share your photos in seconds. Edit. Resize. Create. Share.

tools.title: Every tool in one app
tools.body: Crop and rotate, filters, text and watermarks, social media sizes, collages and batch processing.

privacy.title: Your photos stay on your device
privacy.body: Everything is processed on your phone. No account, no upload, no access to your whole gallery: you only share the photos you pick.
